blocks.html: Good people. High standards. Room to grow.
If you have bartended a Saturday, waited tables, or run a shop that actually cares, you already know the hard parts. We can teach cannabis. Warmth is the part we hire for.

blocks.html: Final schedules, compensation, benefits, and start dates will be discussed in interviews. Bayport is open. We opened October 5, 2026, and we're excited to be open. Employment remains subject to applicable cannabis-worker background checks.

blocks.html: Slow first. Fast later.

Minnesota's adult-use supply chain is still developing. Our menu is narrower than mature-market shops for now. We're honest about what is in stock, help people choose from what we have, and add depth as licensed supply grows.
Early days: training, organizing, cleaning, receiving, refining. Later: a busy bar. Quick decisions, multiple customers, constant resets, plenty of personality.
